name: New Fangled Insight Engine
description: integrates with the New Fangled Insight Engine analytics service.
project_description:
Provides integration for the Newfangled insight engine .

 Features 
 
 Page hit tracking 
 Registers content creation/updates with Insight Engine 
 Integrate with the Insight Engine Sandbox or Production environments 
 Debug mode 
 Integrates with Webform for conversion tracking 
 Entity reference fields (e.g. taxonomy terms) are tracked as Insight Engine terms 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Log in to Insight Engine and generate your token.
